Container.Name: Labby
Container.Overview: Labby is a self-hosted homelab inventory, topology, rack, IP documentation, SSH console and encrypted backup platform.
Container.Description: Document hardware, VMs, LXC containers, applications, networks, racks and relationships in one responsive interface. Labby includes Tree, Graph and IP views, browser-based SSH sessions, scoped Agent API keys, encrypted local backups and direct SMB backup destinations.
Container.Requires: Docker must be enabled. The selected host port must be available and the appdata path must be writable.
Container.Changes: Version 1.0.8: Fix tablet context menus and add 3U blank, UPS and PDU components plus a 2U KVM to rack modeling.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port used to open the Labby web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Labby data, configuration, encrypted SMB credentials, backups and backup key.
